$comment: NPC combat definitions - server-side only. Client loads animations dynamically. `projectile` is the projectile graphic id an npc's ranged/magic attack draws; without it the default generic arrow/magic projectile is used. `deathTicks` is how long the death animation plays before the death itself (drops, removal); 2 when absent. `respawn` is the ticks from removal to respawn; 25 when absent, 0 to disable.
